name: Excalidraw
tagline: The hand-drawn whiteboard. Drawings save into the app's own file.
description:
Sketch boxes, arrows, handwriting and diagrams the way Excalidraw always has — the rough ink, the infinite canvas, undo, export to PNG or SVG or the open .excalidraw file. This copy is the editor alone — no live collaboration room. What you draw is saved on this device and is still there when you open it again.

Drop a .excalidraw file on the canvas to open it. Export when you want a picture or a file you can email. Images you paste stay in the drawing, on this device. There is no share-link, because there is no server to put it on.

An unofficial port of Excalidraw (MIT). This copy drops the collaboration cloud and keeps the editor.
